opening.argument: The presentation directly promotes participation in the Polybius ICO while assuring viewers that the token has strong prospects: “There are plenty of ground for think that this is a very successful token.” It then closes with an explicit invitation to participate: “So please join us, everyone is waiting for your success.” The displayed ICO structure reinforces that solicitation through an open sale allocating 93% of tokens and time-based bonuses declining from +25% on day 1 to zero in week 5. A special presale offer adds 25% tokens for investments of at least 10,000 USD. Together, these features encourage viewers to purchase the promoted token rather than neutrally explaining the project.
